claims.body: The Mammoth are one of the league’s best for shot volume, but the Sabres are near the top at keeping shots away. We’ll side with the Mammoth.

claims.head: Don’t buy Vejmelka’s record against the Sabres
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Vejmelka has been a wall against the Sabres, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Sabres finally get to him.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Buffalo: .929 save percentage · .896 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Vejmelka’s record against the Sabres.
claims.call: If Vejmelka starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .896 than to his .929 against the Sabres.
